stories.title: Space Is Not Silent
stories.description: A short cinematic space fact revealing how the universe is filled with violent motion, sound, and energy.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic view of deep space filled with stars and nebulae. First 1–2 seconds: sudden fast camera push-in toward a glowing region of space (zoom shock), creating immediate impact, then motion quickly stabilizes into a slow, smooth forward drift. Subtle cosmic dust particles moving, distant stars stretching slightly during the push-in. Cinematic lighting, high contrast, realistic space scale, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: HOOK: Use a sudden zoom shock into deep space to instantly grab attention, then settle into calm motion so the viewer understands something unexpected is about to be revealed.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic visualization of space waves traveling through a vast nebula. scenes.visual_reference: Explain the fact visually: space carries pressure waves and vibrations, even though humans cannot hear them directly.
